speaker: 서연
korean_text: 민수 씨, 아까 몇 번이나 전화했는데 왜 핸드폰이 꺼져 있었어요?
translation: Minsu, I called you several times earlier, why was your phone turned off?

speaker: 민수
korean_text: 아, 배터리가 없어서 꺼져 있었어요. 중요한 회의 중이라 확인을 못 했어요.
translation: Ah, it was off because I ran out of battery. I couldn't check since I was in an important meeting.

speaker: 서연
korean_text: 그랬군요. 급한 일인 줄 알고 걱정했어요.
translation: I see. I was worried thinking it was something urgent.

speaker: 민수
korean_text: 죄송해요. 지금은 이동 중이라 긴 통화는 하기 어렵습니다.
translation: I'm sorry. I'm moving right now, so it is difficult to have a long call.

speaker: 서연
korean_text: 네, 괜찮아요. 도착하시면 편하실 때 메시지 남겨 주세요.
translation: Yes, it's fine. When you arrive and have time, please leave a message.

speaker: 민수
translation: Yes, I will contact you immediately as soon as I arrive.
